name: How do I know if my child's birth injury was caused by medical negligence?
description: Medical negligence is determined by evaluating if a healthcare provider's actions fell below the standard of care, which a lawyer can help assess.

mainEntity.name: How do I know if my child's birth injury was caused by medical negligence?

acceptedAnswer.text: Determining if a birth injury resulted from medical negligence requires a thorough review of medical records and expert analysis. Medical negligence occurs when a healthcare provider deviates from the accepted standard of care, leading to harm. This could involve delayed C-sections, failure to monitor fetal distress, or improper use of forceps. A birth injury lawyer can evaluate your case, consult with medical experts, and determine if there's a basis for a claim.
